comp_analysis.reasoning: Recent sale in the same school-market context provides a useful anchor. Its substantially larger reported finished area, much larger parcel and additional half bath indicate a downward adjustment toward the subject. The subject has somewhat greater garage capacity. Unknown grade split and unverified interior condition prevent a reliable dollar adjustment.

Recent nearby sale with similar vintage and wooded setting. Larger reported finished area, more garage storage and reportedly updated kitchen and primary bath favor this comp and indicate a downward adjustment. The subject's additional full bath and ranch layout partly offset those differences, but their market contributions are unquantified.

Recent nearby sale has similar bedroom count, full baths and garage capacity. Subject is newer, has a somewhat larger parcel and more reported total finished area. Comp reportedly has renovated kitchen and bath finishes, an additional half bath, sunroom and pool. These differences offset in part; the dated subject finishes support a lower indication, while pool contribution remains uncertain.

Useful recent lower bracket with similar above-grade area and lot size. Subject's finished walkout lower level, additional full bath and larger garage support an upward adjustment. Comp's reportedly remodeled kitchen offsets part of that advantage. Architectural differences and absence of a basement limit direct comparability.

Same subdivision and similar lot, garage and walkout features make this geographically relevant. Its substantially larger reported finished area, extra half bath and potentially superior finishes indicate a downward adjustment. The transaction is over two years old, and no supported market-time adjustment is available, so it receives little weight.

result.rationale: Four recent completed sales establish a usable local bracket, with the older same-subdivision sale providing limited secondary context. The subject's dated finishes and smaller size or parcel relative to several higher-priced comps support a value below those transactions. Its approximately 2,100 above-grade square feet, finished walkout, three full baths and large attached garage support a value above the smaller no-basement comp. Reconciliation supports a midpoint near $740,000, with a broad range because comparable condition, grade splits, bedroom legality and major-system condition remain unresolved. The 2013 subject sale is too old to update without a supported market trend.
assumptions: Recent comparable sales were arm's-length transactions without material undisclosed concessions.
Subject has approximately 2,100 above-grade and 1,000 finished below-grade square feet, with below-grade space contributing less per square foot than above-grade space.
No five-bedroom premium is assumed; the floor plan supports three labeled bedrooms plus other rooms.
Subject has no material undisclosed structural, moisture, well or septic defects.
No numerical market-time adjustment is applied because the packet supplies no supported appreciation series.
